label: Automation
info:
Baseline seed flow, baked into the Docker image.

Render Free has no persistent disk, so anything you build in the
editor here lives only in /data and is LOST on the next redeploy
or cold start after spin-down. To keep changes permanently:
  1. Menu (top-right) -> Export -> All flows -> copy to clipboard
  2. Paste over the contents of flows-seed.json in your repo
  3. Commit + push -> Render redeploys with your flow baked in

See scripts/ for example Python helpers (Google Sheets, Edge-TTS,
yt-dlp) you can call from an exec node, and the README for a
Google Sheets append flow, a TTS+FFmpeg flow, and a retry pattern
using the Catch node.

name: Retry / error-handling pattern
info:
Wire a Catch node (scope: this tab, or specific nodes) to a
function node that checks msg.retryCount and re-injects the
original message through a Delay node (fixed or exponential
backoff) back into your flow. Give up and alert (e.g. via the
email node) after N attempts. This keeps retry logic visible in
the editor instead of hidden in application code.
